title: Handheld Virus Concentration Method Using a Hollow Fiber Filter Module
author: Higuchi, Satou, et al.
materials: 300 kDa hollow fiber (HF) filter, 115 cm2 (Repligen, D02-E300-05-S)
100 kDa centrifugal ultrafiltration device (CUD) filter (Millipore Sigma, UFC910024)
Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium/Nutrient Mixture F-12 (DMEM/F12)

The concentration of Zika viral RNA increased 38.7-fold using the HF method and 31.6-fold using the CUD method (Table 2). The recovery of Zika viral RNA was 95% using the HF method and 79% using the CUD method. Zika viral RNA in the permeate was less than 1.0 x 104 copies/µL for both concentration methods, indicating that Zika virus did not penetrate the 300 kDa HF or 100 kDa CUD membranes.Table 2The concentration of Zika virus RNA and concentration factors are shown. Zika virus RNA copy number was determined by quantitative real-time PCR. For the HF method, means and standard deviations were calculated based on experimental triplicates. Zika virus RNA was extracted using an RNA isolation kit (Qiagen, 52906), and PCR was performed using a real-time PCR kit (Qiagen, 204443) with Zika virus primer/probe mix (Primerdesign, Path-ZIKV-standard).Table 2MaterialsZika Virus RNA (copies/µL)Concentration factorClarified harvest3.1 x 107HF concentration (n=3)1.2 x 109 ± 1.1 x 10838.7 ± 3.5CUD concentration (n=1)9.8 x 10831.6Data are presented as mean ± standard deviation

steps.title: Culture Vero cells and propagate virus
steps.instruction: Grow Vero cells in a 10‑layer cell‑factory until confluent in DMEM/F12 + 1 % FBS, rinse with fresh DMEM/F12, inoculate Zika virus and propagate for 3 days in DMEM/F12 without FBS.

steps.title: Clarify virus harvest
steps.instruction: Filter the culture supernatant through a 0.22 µm filter to obtain clarified virus harvest.

steps.title: Assemble hollow‑fiber concentration circuit
steps.instruction: Connect a new 50 mL syringe to one side of the permeate port (cap the opposite side). Connect a new 50 mL syringe to one HF inlet and connect another 50 mL syringe containing the clarified harvest to the second inlet.

steps.title: Concentrate virus by syringe recirculation
steps.instruction: Repeatedly inject clarified harvest from its inlet syringe into the opposite inlet syringe, allowing permeate to collect in the permeate‑port syringe; when the permeate syringe is full, discard its contents and reconnect. Refill the inlet syringe with clarified harvest until the entire 200 mL volume has passed through the HF module. If the retentate volume falls below 50 mL, replace the inlet syringe with a new 10 mL syringe. Continue cycles until 1–2 mL of concentrated virus remains (measure with a 10 mL syringe), then cap the permeate port.

substeps.instruction: Inject clarified harvest into the opposite inlet syringe and move the inlet syringe freely (repeat several times).
When the permeate syringe fills, discard permeate and reconnect the syringe.
Refill inlet syringe repeatedly until all 200 mL of clarified harvest has been processed.
Switch an inlet syringe to a 10 mL syringe if retentate volume < 50 mL.
Stop when 1–2 mL of concentrate is measured; cap permeate port.

steps.title: Harvest concentrated virus
steps.instruction: Collect the final 1–2 mL of concentrated virus into a 10 mL syringe.

steps.title: Rinse HF module with PBS
steps.instruction: Prepare 1× PBS in a 10 mL syringe (volume calculated so that the final pooled volume will be 5 mL). Inject the PBS several times into the opposite side of the HF module to rinse, then collect the rinse fluid into a 10 mL syringe.

steps.title: Pool concentrate and rinse
steps.instruction: Combine the concentrated virus harvested in step 5 with the PBS rinse collected in step 6 to obtain a final volume of approximately 5 mL.
